definitions.explanation: A white crystalline substance (sodium chloride) used for seasoning and preserving food. An essential cooking ingredient.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}を{少|すこ}し{入|い}れてください。
この{料理|りょうり}は{塩|しお}が{足|た}りません。
examples.english: This dish doesn't have enough salt.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}と{砂糖|さとう}を{間違|まちが}えました。

notes: A fundamental seasoning in Japanese cooking. {塩味|しおあじ} means 'salty flavor'. Related expressions: {塩辛|しおから}い (salty), {塩焼|しおや}き (salt-grilled). Salt also has cultural significance in Shinto purification rituals.
